source_note: NATO Wales Summit declaration established the Defence Investment Pledge and the 2% GDP benchmark path.
Chancellor Scholz announced a EUR 100bn Bundeswehr special fund and annual defence investment above 2% of GDP.
NATO Vilnius communique framed 2% of GDP as a floor rather than a ceiling for defence spending.
NATO Secretary General said 18 Allies were expected to spend 2% of GDP on defence in 2024.
UK Prime Minister announced defence spending would rise to 2.5% of GDP by 2030.
NATO Washington declaration said more than 2% would be needed in many cases and highlighted 18% growth by European Allies and Canada in 2024.
UK Prime Minister brought forward the 2.5% GDP defence-spending target to 2027 and set a 3% ambition for the next parliament.
European Commission ReArm Europe / Readiness 2030 plan aimed to mobilise up to EUR 800bn for defence investment.
NATO Hague Summit declaration committed Allies to investing 5% of GDP annually in defence and security-related spending by 2035.
